component: Calder Find Your Fit / Fitment Finder

correction_v2_verification.previous_issue: By Vehicle shell was excessively tall and had lost the selected-vehicle region.
correction_v2_verification.current_visual_evidence: v3 restores a compact desktop shell approximately 368px high, reinstates the right-side selected-vehicle region/divider, and removes the large empty lower field.

correction_v2_verification.previous_issue: The two desktop modes used materially different shell geometry.
correction_v2_verification.current_visual_evidence: v3 uses the same outer shell, heading origin, divider/status region, control baseline, CTA treatment, and overall dimensions in both desktop states.

correction_v2_verification.previous_issue: Technical artwork was absent in By Vehicle and a broken/empty artwork rectangle appeared in By Wheel Style.
correction_v2_verification.current_visual_evidence: The broken rectangle is gone and both states now show the same faint wheel/ring treatment. The fuller wheel engineering/contour-flow treatment from the approved reference is still substantially reduced, but it no longer causes a structural or readability defect.
v3 shows one clean '2026 BMW M4 Competition' value.

correction_v2_verification.previous_issue: Component mixed incompatible serif and sans typography across heading, controls, CTA, status, and actions.
correction_v2_verification.current_visual_evidence: The main heading is corrected to the modern Calder sans treatment, but supporting copy, form labels/values, CTA text, and selected-vehicle content still visibly use a serif face, leaving the UI typographically inconsistent with the approved reference.

correction_v2_verification.previous_issue: Unapproved Popular Searches row remained with default browser-link styling.
correction_v2_verification.current_visual_evidence: Popular Searches is absent from both v3 desktop states and no default blue links remain.

correction_v2_verification.previous_issue: Selected-vehicle/status/action region could not be verified in the v2 mobile capture.
correction_v2_verification.current_visual_evidence: v3 mobile clearly continues below the CTA into a separated YOUR VEHICLE region. The component remains single-column/2×2 where appropriate, with practical controls, prominent CTA, and no visible horizontal overflow. The lower actions fall below the 844px viewport and are naturally reachable by vertical scroll.

regression_check.summary: No new material regression detected. Desktop shell geometry, selected-vehicle persistence, tab-mode consistency, CTA/control alignment, elevation, and mobile responsive structure remain stable.

remaining_material_corrections.baseline_requirement: The approved Calder component uses a coherent modern supporting UI typography system. Form labels, select values, CTA, selected-vehicle hierarchy/status/actions, and supporting copy should visually belong to the same Calder type system as the approved reference.
remaining_material_corrections.observed_v3_implementation: FIND YOUR FIT is now correctly modern/sans, but the supporting description, selector labels/values, FIND WHEELS label, and selected-vehicle content still render in a visibly contrasting serif face on desktop and mobile.
remaining_material_corrections.discrepancy: Typography normalization from correction.v2 remains incomplete. The mixed serif/sans treatment is visible across primary interactive UI and materially affects brand fidelity and component cohesion.
remaining_material_corrections.measurable_recommended_correction: Keep the current FIND YOUR FIT treatment unchanged. Apply the approved Calder supporting sans/UI font token to the description, selector labels, selector values, CTA label, YOUR VEHICLE eyebrow/value, confirmation text, Change Vehicle, and Reset. Preserve the current v3 sizes, weights, spacing, control geometry, and line-height relationships unless the font substitution requires only minor optical adjustment.
remaining_material_corrections.acceptance_condition: Across desktop By Vehicle, desktop By Wheel Style, and mobile, the interactive/supporting UI no longer presents a contrasting serif type system; the existing v3 geometry and hierarchy remain stable after the approved supporting font is applied.

non_material_tolerances: Technical artwork remains simpler/fainter than the approved reference, but the broken asset/container defect is resolved and the remaining decorative difference does not materially affect hierarchy, readability, interaction clarity, or responsive usability.
Minor tab/control/CTA measurement differences are within implementation tolerance and do not justify another correction by themselves.
preserve_from_v3: Current desktop shell width and approximately 368px main-panel height.
Stable shared geometry between By Vehicle and By Wheel Style.
Current modern FIND YOUR FIT heading treatment and bronze FIT emphasis.
Current selected-vehicle panel structure and single vehicle value.
Current restrained bronze/green hierarchy and hero subordination.
Current mobile 2×2 controls, CTA, vertical flow, and no-overflow behavior.
